Saudi Arabia has shut down the critical East-West oil pipeline after Thursday's attack on multiple pumping stations. 

The pipeline carried roughly 7 million barrels per day of crude, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. https://t.co/pV1j69IsJB
Notably, the damage to the pumping station was so severe that it was visible on the ultra-low-res Sentinel-3. https://t.co/m3Ir9vXVCX
